loopkeeper.privacy.title: गोपनीयता
loopkeeper.privacy.headline: आपका डेटा आपका है।
loopkeeper.privacy.subhead: कोई संपर्क टेलीमेट्री नहीं, संपर्कों की बिक्री नहीं, जब तक आप न चुनें कोई क्लाउड कॉपी नहीं।
loopkeeper.privacy.pledgeBody: LoopKeeper उपयोग के लिए फ़ोन नंबर, ईमेल या पहचान आवश्यक नहीं है। आप जो भी साझा करते हैं वह स्वैच्छिक है। हम व्यक्तिगत डेटा एकत्र नहीं करते — इसलिए भले ही बाहरी AI या फोरेंसिक जाँच हमें खंगाले, मिलने के लिए कोई पहचान भंडार नहीं है।

loopkeeper.privacy.cloudBody: जब आप Dropbox, Drive या OneDrive पर भेजते हैं, तो पैकेज डिवाइस छोड़ने से पहले आपके पासफ़्रेज़ से एन्क्रिप्ट होता है। प्रदाता केवल सिफरटेक्स्ट देखता है।
loopkeeper.privacy.shareBody: निमंत्रण केवल उसी पल को साझा करता है जिसे आपने भेजना चुना। बाकी कार्ड निजी रहता है — LoopKeeper आपके संदर्भ का स्थानीय उपयोग करता है, कभी सार्वजनिक प्रोफ़ाइल के रूप में नहीं।

loopkeeper.welcome.intro.title: LoopKeeper — close the loop you keep meaning to close
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.copy: Start with one person you keep meaning to contact. Set the rhythm. Close the loop.
loopkeeper.welcome.intro.surprise: Stay to the end — we’ll close one real loop together.
loopkeeper.welcome.card.title: The card is everything
loopkeeper.welcome.card.copy: Every person you keep meaning to reach is a card. Tap it — everything for that one person lives there. Start with the few who matter most; add more as you close the current.
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.title: No more “I keep meaning to”
loopkeeper.welcome.loopmotto.copy: Every missed reply starts the same way: “I keep meaning to.” LoopKeeper catches that thought before it cools — it reads the deep context, surfaces the person you owe, and hands you the words while the moment is still warm. The loop closes before the fire goes cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.title: The deep context
loopkeeper.welcome.fourws.copy: Who, What, Where, When — the story behind every card. The best secretaries always knew it: knowing the background of relationships and transactions is what makes every follow-up, signal and draft land.
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.title: The follow-up engine
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.copy: It reads the deep context and schedules the check-ins you keep meaning to make, surfacing who you owe a reply — the small loops caught before they go cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.followup.emphasis: You no longer forget. You no longer delay. You no longer postpone.
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.title: The AI drafts — you hit Send
loopkeeper.welcome.confidante.copy: The Assistant reads your card and writes the message in your own voice — no more drafting at midnight, no more wondering what to say.
loopkeeper.welcome.storage.title: Where your essentials live
loopkeeper.welcome.storage.copy: Your cards stay where you put them.
loopkeeper.welcome.pricing.title: Basic $1 · Assistant $5
loopkeeper.welcome.pricing.copy: Seven days free with the Assistant at full strength. Basic catches five loops a month — enough to clear what’s owed. Assistant catches them all. Billing lives in Settings.
loopkeeper.welcome.outro.title: That’s the tour — it’s all live
loopkeeper.welcome.outro.copy: You’re set. Pick your first person — we’ll start there. Replay this demo any time from Settings → Welcome Again.
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.title: Let’s close one real loop — right now
loopkeeper.welcome.taste.copy: Pick the person you keep meaning to text. We’ll work through that one together: compose the message, then you send.
loopkeeper.welcome.st.mottoCatch: The loop closes before the fire goes cold.
loopkeeper.welcome.st.fuPriya: Priya — how did the interview go?
loopkeeper.welcome.st.sigUpdateSub: her card caught it too — live across devices
loopkeeper.welcome.st.wFoot: the Assistant reads the story, finds the words, and hands them to you
loopkeeper.welcome.st.ask: What do I say to Priya about the interview?
loopkeeper.welcome.st.reply: Hey Priya — huge congrats on getting to the interview. How did it go? Rooting for you. 💛

loopkeeper.welcome.st.taste3: The thank-you that died in drafts
loopkeeper.welcome.st.tasteHint: No names, no numbers — you pick the person from your phone at the end.
loopkeeper.welcome.privacyBody: LoopKeeper requires no phone number, no email, no identity. LoopKeeper does not need your personal data to serve you. So even if an external AI or forensic scan successfully digs into us, there is no identity trove to find.

loopkeeper.meter.hint2: Send and close — receipts build the streak.

loopkeeper.welcome.meter.title: One sentence separates you from autopilot
loopkeeper.welcome.meter.copy: Without your captures, LoopKeeper is just another contacts app — the one your phone already has. The Loop-O-meter shows this honestly. Capture a single loop and the engine wakes: drafts, nudges, receipts — climbing from Contacts manager to Loop tracker, Loop closer, and finally Autopilot.
